name: Joseph
summary: Jacob's favorite son, sold by his envious brothers into Egypt. God raised him up to rule Egypt, and through him his family was kept alive in a famine.

key_moments.title: The Coat and the Dreams
key_moments.description: Jacob loved Joseph most and made him a many-colored coat. Joseph dreamed that his family would bow down to him, and his brothers hated him even more.

key_moments.title: Sold by His Brothers
key_moments.description: His brothers stripped off his coat and threw him into an empty pit. Then they sold him for twenty silver pieces, and he was carried off to Egypt.

key_moments.title: Falsely Accused
key_moments.description: Joseph refused his master's wife and ran from her, leaving his garment in her hand. She accused him, and he was put in prison, but the LORD stayed with him there.

key_moments.title: Ruler over Egypt
key_moments.description: Joseph told Pharaoh his dreams meant seven years of plenty followed by seven of famine. Pharaoh put his own ring on Joseph's hand and made him ruler over all Egypt.

key_moments.title: I Am Joseph
key_moments.description: Joseph sent everyone out, wept aloud, and told his brothers who he was. He said God had sent him ahead of them to save their lives.
